config._note: performance-reviews-mvp (2026-07-13): the orchestration half of the performance-review MVP (ADR-001 Rule 6 — sub-pages under the EXISTING Personeel/EmployeesGroup, no new top-level menu). The 'Cycle' data widget carries every field (name/year/type/status/startDate/endDate — no $ref to exclude, ReviewCycle has no outbound relations). The 'Beoordelingen in deze cyclus' object-list (PerformanceReview.cycleId = @objectId) is the cycle's in-progress roster, rowRoute to PerformanceReviewDetail. lifecycleActions expose exactly openen/sluiten (concept->open->gesloten, hr-performance.json) -- no re-open edge, a closed cycle is history (the Vacancy no-resurrection precedent). Audit history is a sidebar tab. goals-okr (2026-07-15) adds the 'OKR's in deze cyclus' object-list (Objective.cycleId = @objectId) — the review-period tie: an OKR set can optionally be tied to a beoordelingscyclus.

params.title: Review
params.note: performance-reviews-mvp (2026-07-13): the dossier half of the performance-review MVP (ADR-001 Rule 6 — the primary surface is actually the EmployeeDetail emp-reviews row; this page is a routed detail, reached from that row, the cycle's review list, or the deepLink, and is deliberately NOT a menu child, the TimesheetDetail convention). The 'Beoordeling' data widget carries rating/sterktes/ontwikkelpunten/afspraken/goals/besprokenOp/vastgesteldDoor, excluding employeeId/cycleId/reviewerId (Related resolves and links all three by name) and userId (the internal @me self-service field, not a display fact). Goals are recorded INSIDE this review (design D2 — no separate Goal entity anywhere in the register); besprokenOp/vastgesteldDoor are stamped on the carrying writes of bespreken/vaststellen. lifecycleActions expose exactly indienen/bespreken/vaststellen/heropenen (hr-performance.json) -- vaststellen is guarded server-side by the existing NoSelfApprovalGuard (the employee under review may not vaststellen their own beoordeling); heropenen is the correction edge back to besproken. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
